data.exact_reserve_text: During the year there was net claims development improvement of GBP 14.7 million on the 2013 and prior years, GBP 1.9 million on the 2014 year, GBP 2.7 million on the 2015 year and an improvement of GBP 0.5 million on the 2016 year of account.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported an overall gross prior year reserve release of GBP 9.290 million. This was driven by favorable claims development on the 2013, 2014, and 2015 years of account, particularly due to reductions in primary professional indemnity and Med Mal reserves, following a comprehensive review of outstanding case reserves and a redistribution of large loss loads. However, the 2016 year of account experienced adverse development, primarily due to strengthening in excess accounts. The managing agent noted significant deterioration in claims reserves during 2015 and 2016, leading to the syndicate entering run-off.
raw_causal_phrases: significant deterioration seen in the claims reserves during 2015
Further significant deterioration occurred in the incurred claims position in the second quarter of 2016
significant decrease in the ultimate claims position... as a consequence of favourable experience over the year
comprehensive review of all outstanding case reserves was conducted by the Claims team
reserves were overly cautious or required strengthening
large loss load was therefore redistributed
reduction to the primary professional indemnity account
release on all accounts particularly PI primary of GBP 2,183k, excess accounts of GBP 2,080k and Med Mal primary of GBP 1,810k
increase in the excess accounts of GBP 6,630k gross following the reallocation of the large loss load
data.data_quality_notes: There is a discrepancy between the aggregate 'Changes for prior years' in Note 17 (-9.290m gross release) and the sum of individual YOA gross movements described in the narrative on page 3 (-21.231m gross release). The narrative on page 16 provides net figures for YOA movements (19.8m net release), which also differs from the net figure in Note 17 (-8.161m net release). The aggregate figure from Note 17 is used for `prior_year_development_gbp_m` as per instructions.
